forms.label: Whole, smoke-dried
forms.sourceNote: Plums, dried (prunes), uncooked. Public domain. FoodData Central carries no record for wumei specifically, which is smoke-dried and considerably more sour than a sun-dried prune; this is the nearest dried-plum match available, marked as an approximation rather than a measurement of the smoked fruit itself. No density: the fruit is boiled and strained out.
